title: phyla nodiflora var. incisa
intro: Phyla nodiflora var. incisa, commonly known as Japanese mountain mint, is a perennial herb native to East Asia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include relief from digestive issues, fever reduction, and anti-inflammatory effects, contributing to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Phyla nodiflora var. incisa include its ability to reduce inflammation, antimicrobial properties, and antioxidant activity, which may help alleviate symptoms associated with various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
